name: @brasa/sdk
description: TypeScript types generated from docs/openapi/v1.json (API-15) -- the single source of truth every hand-written *.dto duplicate in pos/admin/e2e should eventually be checked against, and someday replace. Not yet consumed anywhere: this ships the generator and the generated output, the same 'mechanism before the trigger' shape most of this codebase's other cross-cutting pieces have shipped in. No build step -- consumed by path alias exactly like @brasa/ui, never through node_modules.
